name: EPIC 212693484

text.card: A red giant 1,604 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.02 solar masses and 15.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,389 K at its surface.
